Ettevõte nimetab eraldi teenusena koristust enne ja pärast kolimist ning ehitus- ja remondijärgset koristust. Lisaks tehakse pehme mööbli ja vaipkatete keemilist puhastust, prügiveo korraldamist ja territooriumi hooldust.
rows.descriptionEn: Spodre 7 provides regular and deep cleaning of apartments, houses, offices and stairwells in the Rīga region. Notably it lists pre- and post-relocation cleaning as an explicit service line, alongside post-construction and post-renovation cleaning. It also offers upholstery and carpet dry-cleaning, junk removal and grounds maintenance.

rows.name: SIA EK Pērle
rows.tagline: Uzkopšanas serviss Rīgā un visā Latvijā 24/7 — biroji, dzīvokļi, logi, mēbeles un teritorijas.
rows.descriptionEt: EK Pērle (trp.lv) on Cēsises registreeritud koristusettevõte, mis töötab enda sõnul Riias ja üle kogu Läti ööpäev läbi. Teenuste nimekirjas on kontorite ja korterite koristus, akende pesu, põrandahooldus, mööbli ja vaipade puhastus ning territooriumi hooldus. Ettevõte pakub lisaks mööbli transporti ja hügieenitarvikute tarnet.
rows.descriptionEn: EK Pērle, trading as trp.lv, is a cleaning contractor registered in Cēsis that states it works in Rīga and across Latvia around the clock. Its service list covers office and apartment cleaning, window washing, floor care, furniture and carpet cleaning, and grounds maintenance. It also does furniture transport, disinfection and hygiene-consumable supply.

rows.name: SIA "Teritorijas uzkopšanas serviss"
rows.tagline: Telpu un teritoriju uzkopšanas serviss Daugavpilī un Latgalē.
rows.descriptionEt: Teritorijas uzkopšanas serviss on Daugavpilsi koristusettevõte, mis on kantud Läti ärikataloogi zl.lv koristusteenuste rubriiki. Ettevõte tegeleb ruumide ja territooriumide koristusega Daugavpilsis ja Latgale piirkonnas. Ettevõttel ei ole leitavat omaenda veebilehte, kontaktandmed pärinevad kataloogist.
rows.descriptionEn: Teritorijas uzkopšanas serviss is a Daugavpils cleaning contractor listed in the zl.lv business directory under cleaning services. It covers interior premises and outdoor territory cleaning in Daugavpils and the wider Latgale region. No company website could be found, so the contact details come from directory listings only.

rows.name: SIA CleanGuard
rows.tagline: Uzkopšanas serviss Daugavpilī — telpu tīrīšana un uzkopšana pēc remonta.
rows.descriptionEt: CleanGuard on Daugavpilsis tegutsev koristusettevõte, mis on kirjas zl.lv koristusteenuste kataloogis. Ettevõte pakub ruumide koristust Daugavpilsis ja lähipiirkonnas. Omaenda veebilehte ei õnnestunud leida, seega kontaktandmed on kataloogist.
rows.descriptionEn: CleanGuard is a cleaning company operating in Daugavpils, listed in the zl.lv cleaning-services directory. It provides premises cleaning in Daugavpils and the surrounding area. No own website was found, so its contact details are directory-sourced only.

rows.name: SIA "Cleanland PHS"
rows.tagline: Vairāk nekā 15 gadu pieredze uzkopšanā Ventspilī — regulārā uzkopšana, ģenerāltīrīšana un logu mazgāšana.
rows.descriptionEt: Cleanland PHS on Ventspilsis tegutsev koristusettevõte, millel on enda andmetel üle viieteistkümne aasta kogemust. Pakutakse regulaarset ruumide koristust, generaalkoristust, põrandate vahatamist, pehme mööbli ja vaipade keemilist puhastust ning akende pesu. Ettevõte kasutab kvaliteedijuhtimiseks oma digilahendust CLEANLAND +.
rows.descriptionEn: Cleanland PHS is a Ventspils cleaning company with more than fifteen years of stated experience. It offers regular premises cleaning, deep cleaning, floor waxing, chemical cleaning of upholstery and carpets, and window washing. The firm runs its own digital quality-management system branded CLEANLAND +.

rows.name: ProClean (Tapiņš N., individuālā darba veicējs)
rows.tagline: Mīksto mēbeļu, matraču un paklāju tīrīšana Liepājā.
rows.descriptionEt: ProClean on Liepāja koristusteenuse pakkuja, mis on kantud nii zl.lv kui 1188.lv ärikataloogidesse ühel ja samal aadressil. Põhitegevus on pehme mööbli, madratsite ja vaipade keemiline puhastus. Tegemist on üksikettevõtjaga, omaenda veebilehte ei leitud.
rows.descriptionEn: ProClean is a Liepāja cleaning provider listed at the same address in both the zl.lv and 1188.lv business directories. Its core work is chemical cleaning of upholstered furniture, mattresses and carpets. It trades as a sole proprietorship and no own website could be found.

rows.name: SIA "Tīrības centrs"
rows.tagline: Uzkopšanas pakalpojumi Liepājā un Dienvidkurzemē.
rows.descriptionEt: Tīrības centrs on Liepājas registreeritud koristusettevõte, mis on kirjas zl.lv koristusteenuste kataloogis. Kataloog annab ainult linna ja postiindeksi, täpset tänavaaadressi ei ole avaldatud. Omaenda veebilehte ei leitud, mistõttu andmed on kataloogipõhised.
rows.descriptionEn: Tīrības centrs is a Liepāja-registered cleaning company listed in the zl.lv cleaning-services directory. The directory gives only the city and postcode, with no street address published. No own website was found, so all details here are directory-sourced.

rows.name: SIA CleanSolution
rows.tagline: Uzkopšanas serviss Rēzeknē un Latgalē — telpu tīrīšana un ģenerāltīrīšana.
rows.descriptionEt: CleanSolution on Rēzeknes tegutsev koristusettevõte, mis on kantud zl.lv koristusteenuste kataloogi. Ettevõte pakub ruumide koristust Rēzeknes ja Latgale piirkonnas. Omaenda veebilehte ei leitud, kontaktandmed pärinevad kataloogist.
rows.descriptionEn: CleanSolution is a cleaning company operating in Rēzekne, listed in the zl.lv cleaning-services directory. It provides premises cleaning in Rēzekne and the Latgale region. No own website was found, so the contact details are directory-sourced.

rows.name: SIA "Tīrs un tīrāks"
rows.address: Beātes iela 5, Valmiera, Valmieras novads, LV-4201
rows.tagline: Uzkopšanas pakalpojumi Valmierā un Vidzemē.
rows.descriptionEt: Tīrs un tīrāks on Valmiera kesklinnas registreeritud koristusettevõte, mis on kirjas zl.lv koristusteenuste kataloogis. Ettevõte teenindab Valmiera linna ja Vidzeme piirkonda. Omaenda veebilehte ei leitud.
rows.descriptionEn: Tīrs un tīrāks is a cleaning company registered in central Valmiera and listed in the zl.lv cleaning-services directory. It serves Valmiera town and the surrounding Vidzeme region. No own website was found, so the details are directory-sourced.

rows.name: SIA TIRAM.LV
rows.address: Parka iela 10-18, Ogre, Ogres novads, LV-5001
rows.tagline: Uzkopšanas serviss Ogrē un Ogres novadā.
rows.descriptionEt: TIRAM.LV on Ogres registreeritud koristusettevõte, mis on kantud zl.lv koristusteenuste kataloogi. Ettevõte pakub ruumide koristust Ogres linnas ja Ogre vallas. Ehkki ärinimi viitab domeenile, ei õnnestunud ühtki toimivat veebilehte kinnitada.
rows.descriptionEn: TIRAM.LV is a cleaning company registered in Ogre and listed in the zl.lv cleaning-services directory. It provides premises cleaning in Ogre town and Ogre municipality. Despite the domain-style trade name, no working company website could be verified.

rows.name: SIA WASSER
rows.tagline: Uzkopšanas pakalpojumi Jūrmalā un Rīgas jūras līča piekrastē.
rows.descriptionEt: WASSER on Jūrmalas registreeritud koristusettevõte, mis on kirjas zl.lv koristusteenuste kataloogis. Ettevõte teenindab Jūrmala linna, kus on palju suvekodusid ja lühiajalist üüri. Omaenda veebilehte ei leitud, andmed pärinevad kataloogist.
rows.descriptionEn: WASSER is a cleaning company registered in Jūrmala and listed in the zl.lv cleaning-services directory. It serves the Jūrmala resort area, a market with heavy seasonal-home and short-let turnover. No own website was found, so the details are directory-sourced.

rows.name: Darzavarde, IK
rows.tagline: Telpu uzkopšana un teritoriju kopšana Jelgavā un Zemgalē.
rows.descriptionEt: Darzavarde on Jelgavas registreeritud üksikettevõte, mis on kantud zl.lv koristusteenuste kataloogi. Tegeletakse ruumide koristuse ja territooriumi hooldusega Jelgavas ning Zemgale piirkonnas. Omaenda veebilehte ei leitud.
rows.descriptionEn: Darzavarde is a sole-trader business registered in Jelgava and listed in the zl.lv cleaning-services directory. It handles premises cleaning and grounds maintenance in Jelgava and the Zemgale region. No own website was found, so the details are directory-sourced.

rows.name: SIA "Estetik Pluss"
rows.tagline: Ģenerālā uzkopšana un uzkopšana pēc remonta — minimums ķīmijas, maksimums rūpēs par cilvēkiem un vidi.
rows.descriptionEt: Estetik Pluss on Iecavas registreeritud koristusettevõte, mis teenindab Riia ja Zemgale piirkonda. Pakutakse generaalkoristust, remondijärgset koristust, kontorite regulaarhooldust, akende pesu ning pehme mööbli ja vaipade puhastust. Ettevõtte hinnakiri algab generaalkoristuse puhul 1,50 eurost ruutmeetri kohta ilma käibemaksuta.
rows.descriptionEn: Estetik Pluss is a cleaning company registered in Iecava that serves the Rīga and Zemgale regions. It offers deep cleaning, post-renovation cleaning, regular office maintenance, window washing and upholstery/carpet cleaning, and markets a low-chemical approach. Published pricing for a general clean runs EUR 1.50-4.00 per square metre excluding VAT.

rows.name: Zebra Cargo SIA
rows.address: Ziemeļu iela 14, Rīgas lidosta, Mārupes novads, LV-1053
rows.tagline: Profesionāla mantu, mēbeļu un mākslas darbu iepakošana ar sertificētiem materiāliem kopš 1998. gada.
rows.descriptionEt: Zebra Cargo on 1998. aastast tegutsev kolimis- ja logistikaettevõte Riia lennujaama juures Mārupes. Ettevõte turundab asjade pakkimist eraldi teenusena, kasutades sertifitseeritud pakkematerjale, sealhulgas kunstiteoste ja muuseumiesemete pakendamiseks. Lisaks pakutakse valvega laopinda ning kohalikke ja rahvusvahelisi kolimisi.
rows.descriptionEn: Zebra Cargo has operated since 1998 from the Rīga Airport area in Mārupe, doing local and international household and office moves. It markets packing as a distinct service using certified materials, including specialist crating for art and museum pieces. It also runs guarded storage warehouses, and quotes van-plus-crew work from around EUR 50 per hour.

rows.name: PaperSeal
rows.tagline: Transportēšanas un pārvākšanās kastes, gofrētais kartons un iepakojuma materiāli Rīgā.
rows.descriptionEt: PaperSeal on Riia pakkematerjalide tarnija Daugavgrīvas tänaval. Ettevõte müüb transpordikaste, gofreeritud kartongi ja pakkematerjale ning tal on eraldi tootekategooria kolimiskastidele. See on üks väheseid Läti pakkematerjalide müüjaid, kes kolimiskaste eraldi rubriigina turundab.
rows.descriptionEn: PaperSeal is a Rīga packaging supplier based on Daugavgrīvas iela, selling transport and retail packaging, corrugated cardboard and packing consumables. It maintains a dedicated product category for moving boxes (pārvākšanās kastes). It is one of the few Latvian packaging retailers that markets moving boxes as a distinct line rather than only industrial cartons.

rows.name: SIA "Jelgavas pakotājs rūpnīca MARSS" (PakoShop)
rows.tagline: Kartona kastes un iepakojuma materiāli tieši no ražotāja Jelgavā — cenas no 0,25 EUR par kasti.
rows.descriptionEt: Jelgavas pakotājs rūpnīca MARSS on Jelgavas asuv kartongpakendite tootja, mis müüb e-poe PakoShop kaudu otse tehasest. Sortimendis on eri suuruses kartongkastid, pakiautomaadi kastid, transpordikastid, kinkekarbid ning teip ja venivkile. Kastide hinnad algavad 0,25 eurost ja ulatuvad ligi kuue euroni.
rows.descriptionEn: Jelgavas pakotājs rūpnīca MARSS is a cardboard packaging manufacturer in Jelgava selling direct from the factory through its PakoShop e-shop. Its range covers cardboard boxes in many sizes, parcel-locker boxes, transport cartons, gift boxes, tape and stretch film. Box prices run from EUR 0.25 to about EUR 5.93, though the catalogue is aimed at shipping rather than household moves.

rows.name: ROOT apdrošināšanas brokeri
rows.tagline: Kravu apdrošināšana un CMR — individuāls risinājums Latvijā, Baltijā, Eiropā un NVS valstīs.
rows.descriptionEt: ROOT on Riia kindlustusmaakler, kellel on eraldi tootelehekülg veosekindlustusele ja CMR-vastutuskindlustusele. Maakler kaardistab kliendi riskid, võrdleb kindlustusandjate pakkumisi ja vormistab poliisi, kattes Läti, Baltikumi, Euroopa ja SRÜ suunad. Kaetakse ka eriveosed nagu alkohol, tubakas, ohtlikud ained ja negabariitne kaup.
rows.descriptionEn: ROOT is a Rīga insurance broker with a dedicated product page for cargo insurance and CMR carrier liability. It maps the client's risk, compares offers from multiple insurers and places the policy, covering Latvia, the Baltics, Europe and CIS routes. It explicitly handles special cargo classes such as alcohol, tobacco, hazardous goods and oversized freight.

rows.name: VIS BROKERHOUSE, SIA
rows.address: Kārļa Ulmaņa gatve 2, 5. stāvs, Rīga, LV-1004
rows.tagline: Neatkarīgs apdrošināšanas brokeris — kravu apdrošināšana, autotransports un civiltiesiskā atbildība.
rows.descriptionEt: VIS Brokerhouse on Riia kindlustusmaakler, mis on registreeritud finantsjärelevalve juures alates 2009. aastast ja tegutses varem nime all Vingo Insurance Services. Toodete nimekirjas on eraldi välja toodud veosekindlustus koos autotranspordi-, vara- ja vastutuskindlustusega. Ettevõte tegutseb sõltumatu maaklerina ja võrdleb turul olevaid pakkumisi.
rows.descriptionEn: VIS Brokerhouse is a Rīga insurance broker registered with the Latvian financial regulator since 2009, formerly trading as Vingo Insurance Services. Cargo insurance is named explicitly in its product list alongside motor, property, accident, life and general/professional liability cover. It operates as an independent broker comparing offers across the market.

rows.name: SIA "R&D apdrošināšanas brokers"
rows.tagline: Kravu apdrošināšana kravas īpašniekam, nosūtītājam un saņēmējam pret bojājumiem un zudumu pārvadājumā.
rows.descriptionEt: R&D apdrošināšanas brokers on Riia kindlustusmaakler, mis müüb veosekindlustust eraldi tooteartiklina. Kaitse on suunatud kauba omanikule, saatjale ja saajale juhuks, kui veos saab veo ajal kahjustada, kaob või hävib. Maakler vahendab ka muid ettevõtete kindlustusliike ja töötab mitme kindlustusandjaga.
rows.descriptionEn: R&D apdrošināšanas brokers is a Rīga insurance broker that sells cargo insurance as a discrete product line. The cover is aimed at the cargo owner, consignor and consignee against damage, loss or disappearance of goods in transit. It also brokers the broader range of commercial insurance lines across multiple insurers.

rows.name: Apdrošināšanas un Finansu Brokers
rows.tagline: 25 gadu pieredze, sadarbība ar vairāk nekā 30 apdrošinātājiem — tostarp kravu apdrošināšana.
rows.descriptionEt: Apdrošināšanas un Finansu Brokers on üks Läti vanemaid kindlustusmaaklereid, mis on tegutsenud veerand sajandit ja teeb koostööd enam kui kolmekümne kindlustusandjaga. Veosekindlustus on ettevõtte veebilehel eraldi tooteartiklina koos vara-, tervise-, elu-, reisi- ja vastutuskindlustusega. Ettevõte kuulub Läti kindlustusmaaklerite assotsiatsiooni.
rows.descriptionEn: Apdrošināšanas un Finansu Brokers is one of Latvia's longest-established insurance brokers, with 25 years of trading and partnerships with more than thirty insurers. Cargo insurance appears as its own product line on the site alongside property, health, life, travel and liability cover. The firm is a member of the Latvian Insurance Brokers Association.

rows.name: Agento SIA
rows.tagline: CMR apdrošināšana kravu pārvadātājiem — salīdzinām apdrošinātāju piedāvājumus bez maksas klientam.
rows.descriptionEt: Agento on litsentseeritud Läti kindlustusmaakler, millel on eraldi tooteleht vedaja tsiviilvastutuse ehk CMR-kindlustusele. Kate hõlmab rahvusvahelisi ja siseriiklikke autovedusid ning kaitseb vedajat kauba kahjustumise, kaotsimineku või tarnehilinemise korral. Maakler võrdleb kindlustusandjate pakkumisi ja saab tasu kindlustusandjatelt, mitte kliendilt.
rows.descriptionEn: Agento is a licensed Latvian insurance broker with a dedicated product page for CMR carrier civil-liability insurance. The cover applies to international and domestic road haulage, protecting the carrier against cargo damage, loss or delivery delay. It compares offers across insurers and is paid commission by the insurer rather than by the client.

rows.name: KABI piekabju noma — Kleistu iela, Rīga
rows.tagline: Pašapkalpošanās piekabju noma ar KABI lietotni 24/7
rows.descriptionEt: KABI on iseteenindusega haagiserendi vorgustik, mida juhitakse taielikult nutitelefoni rakendusest. Kleistu tanava punktis Riias avatakse haagis Bluetoothi kaudu opaev labi, ilma teenindajata. Hind on 5 eurot esimese tunni eest ja 3 eurot iga jargmise eest, opaeva ulempiir on 18 eurot.
rows.descriptionEn: KABI is a self-service trailer rental network operated entirely through a smartphone app. At the Kleistu iela point in Rīga the trailer is unlocked over Bluetooth 24/7 with no staff on site. Pricing is EUR 5 for the first hour and EUR 3 for each following hour, capped at EUR 18 per day.

rows.name: KABI piekabju noma — Dignājas iela, Rīga
rows.tagline: Iznomā piekabi jebkurā diennakts laikā bez apkalpojošā personāla
rows.descriptionEt: KABI haagiserendi punkt Riia Dignajas tanaval tootab taielikult iseteenindusena mobiilirakenduse kaudu. Valida saab lahtise platvormhaagise ja kinnise kattega haagise vahel. Haagis tuleb tagastada samasse punkti, kust see valja voeti.
rows.descriptionEn: A KABI trailer point on Dignājas iela in Rīga, operating fully self-service through the mobile app. Both an open platform trailer and a closed covered trailer are offered. The trailer must be returned to the same point it was picked up from.

rows.name: KABI piekabju noma — Finiera iela, Rīga
rows.tagline: KABI piekabes Sarkandaugavā — rezervē lietotnē un brauc
rows.descriptionEt: KABI haagiserendi punkt Finiera tanaval Riia pohjaosas. Rendi alustamiseks on vaja nutitelefoni sisselulitatud Bluetoothiga ja kehtivat maksekaarti. Esimesed 15 minutit broneeringust on tasuta ja pikim jarjestikune renditahtaeg on 30 paeva.
rows.descriptionEn: A KABI trailer point on Finiera iela in northern Rīga. To start a rental you need a smartphone with Bluetooth enabled and an active payment card. The first 15 minutes of a booking are free and the maximum continuous rental period is 30 days.

rows.name: KABI piekabju noma — Liepāja
rows.tagline: Piekabju noma Liepājā — 5 EUR pirmā stunda, maksimums 18 EUR diennaktī
rows.descriptionEt: KABI haagiserendi punkt Liepaja Zemnieku tanaval. Hinnakiri on kogu vorgus uhtne: 5 eurot esimese tunni eest, 3 eurot iga jargmise eest ja mitte rohkem kui 18 eurot opaeva kohta. Kahju tuleb rakenduses pildistada enne soidu algust.
rows.descriptionEn: A KABI trailer point on Zemnieku iela in Liepāja. Pricing is identical across the network: EUR 5 for the first hour, EUR 3 for each following hour and never more than EUR 18 per day. Any pre-existing damage must be photographed in the app before setting off.

rows.name: KABI piekabju noma — Ventspils
rows.tagline: KABI piekabes Ventspilī — atver ar telefonu, bez rindām un līgumiem
rows.descriptionEt: KABI haagiserendi punkt Ventspilsi Celtnieku tanaval. Rendileping soolmitakse rakenduses, mistottu paberitood ja jarjekordi ei ole. Vorgustik katab kogu Latit, Gulbenest Ventspilsini.
rows.descriptionEn: A KABI trailer point on Celtnieku iela in Ventspils. The rental agreement is concluded in the app, so there is no paperwork and no queue. The network covers the whole of Latvia, from Gulbene in Vidzeme to Ventspils in Kurzeme.

rows.name: VIADA Baltija AS — DUS Daugavpils 1, piekabju noma
rows.tagline: Piekabju noma degvielas uzpildes stacijā, jautā operatoram no 8:00 līdz 22:00
rows.descriptionEt: VIADA on Lati kutusekett, mis pakub haagiserenti umbes 90 tanklas ule riigi, sealhulgas Daugavpilsi Nometnu tanava jaamas. Haagis renditakse tanklaoperaatori kaest kohapeal kella 8st 22ni. Haagis tuleb tagastada tapselt samasse tanklasse, kust see valja voeti.
rows.descriptionEn: VIADA is a Latvian fuel station chain offering trailer rental at around 90 stations nationwide, including the Nometņu iela station in Daugavpils. Trailers are handed over by the station operator on site between 08:00 and 22:00. The trailer must be returned to exactly the same station it was rented from.

rows.name: VIADA Baltija AS — DUS Rēzekne 2, piekabju noma
rows.tagline: Piekabes noma Rēzeknē — pieejama VIADA uzpildes stacijā Daugavpils ielā
rows.descriptionEt: VIADA tankla Rezekne Daugavpilsi tanaval on uks Latgale haagiserendipunktidest. Renditeenus kaib tanklaoperaatori kaudu, ilma eelbroneeringuta, kuid enne soitu tasub helistada ja vaba haagis ule kontrollida. Kett katab Latgales tihedalt Rezeknet, Ludzat, Kraslavat ja Preilit.
rows.descriptionEn: The VIADA station on Daugavpils iela in Rēzekne is one of the chain's Latgale trailer points. The service runs through the station operator without advance booking, though it is worth calling ahead to confirm a trailer is free. The chain covers Latgale densely, including Rēzekne, Ludza, Krāslava and Preiļi.

rows.name: VIADA Baltija AS — DUS Jēkabpils, piekabju noma
rows.tagline: Vienass piekabes noma Jēkabpilī VIADA degvielas uzpildes stacijā
rows.descriptionEt: VIADA tankla Jekabpilsi Vienibas tanaval rendib uheteljelisi haagiseid. Rent vormistatakse kohapeal tanklas ja tasutakse tanklakassas. Jekabpilsis on ketil neli tanklat, millest mitmes on haagised saadaval.
rows.descriptionEn: The VIADA station on Vienības iela in Jēkabpils rents out single-axle trailers. The rental is arranged and paid for at the station counter. VIADA operates four stations in Jēkabpils, several of which carry trailers.

rows.name: VIADA Baltija AS — DUS Kauguri, piekabju noma
rows.tagline: Piekabju noma Jūrmalā, Kauguros — vienīgais VIADA punkts pilsētā
rows.descriptionEt: VIADA Kauguri tankla on ketti ainus haagiserendipunkt Jurmalas. Asukoht Briksku tanaval sobib hasti suvemajade ja rannaaarsete korterite kolimiseks. Haagised valjastatakse kella 8st 22ni.
rows.descriptionEn: The VIADA Kauguri station is the chain's only trailer point in Jūrmala. Its location on Brikšķu iela suits moves involving summer houses and seaside apartments. Trailers are handed out between 08:00 and 22:00.

rows.name: VIADA Baltija AS — DUS Jelgava 2, piekabju noma
rows.tagline: Piekabju noma Jelgavā pie Lietuvas šosejas, blakus izbraukšanai uz Lietuvu
rows.descriptionEt: VIADA tankla Jelgava Leedu maantee aares rendib haagiseid otse tanklast. Asukoht linna louna servas on mugav neile, kes tulevad Jelgavasse maapiirkonnast. Rendi eest tasutakse tanklas ja haagis tagastatakse samasse kohta.
rows.descriptionEn: The VIADA station on Lietuvas šoseja in Jelgava rents trailers straight from the forecourt. Its position on the southern edge of the city is convenient for customers arriving from the surrounding rural area. Payment is taken at the station and the trailer is returned to the same place.

rows.name: VIADA Baltija AS — DUS Liepāja 3, piekabju noma
rows.tagline: Piekabes noma Liepājā, Ganību ielā — jautā stacijas operatoram
rows.descriptionEt: VIADA tankla Liepaja Ganibu tanaval kuulub keti haagiserendipunktide hulka. Liepajas on VIADA-l kolm tanklat ja haagised on saadaval mitmes neist. Rent kaib operaatori kaudu tanklas lahtiolekuajal.
rows.descriptionEn: The VIADA station on Ganību iela in Liepāja is one of the chain's trailer rental points. VIADA runs three stations in Liepāja and trailers are available at several of them. Rentals are handled by the station operator during opening hours.

rows.name: SIA MEKS GROUP
rows.tagline: Transporta noma Rīgā: kravas un pasažieru mikroautobusi, piekabes, treileri
rows.descriptionEt: MEKS GROUP rendib Riia Akmenu tanavalt kaubikuid, kuni uheksakohalisi reisibusse ja kaheksat eri tuupi haagist kandevoimega 350 kilost 2000 kiloni. Kaubiku opaevarent algab umbes 40 eurost ja ulatub 75 euroni, haagised maksavad 15-30 eurot paevas. Uleandmine kaib fotode ja WhatsAppi teel, lahtiolek 7-22.
rows.descriptionEn: MEKS GROUP rents cargo vans, passenger minibuses seating up to nine and eight different trailer models with load capacities from 350 kg to 2000 kg from its yard on Akmeņu iela in Rīga. Van day rates run roughly EUR 40-75 and trailers EUR 15-30 per day. Handover is documented by photos and handled over WhatsApp, with the yard open 07:00-22:00.

rows.name: PATA TIMBER SIA — piekabes noma Mārupē
rows.tagline: 4,8 metru gara vienass piekabe ar tentu — noma pie veikala Mārupē
rows.descriptionEt: PATA TIMBER on ehitusmaterjalide kaupmees, kes rendib oma Marupe kaupluse juures 4,8 meetri pikkust uheteljelist tendiga haagist. Hind on 6 eurot esimese tunni eest, 3 eurot iga jargmise eest ja 75 eurot opaeva eest, tagatisraha 50 eurot. Rentimiseks on vaja B-kategooria juhiluba ja tellimus vormistatakse veebipoes.
rows.descriptionEn: PATA TIMBER is a building-materials retailer that rents a 4.8 metre single-axle covered trailer from its Mārupe store. The rate is EUR 6 for the first hour, EUR 3 for each following hour and EUR 75 for a full day, with a EUR 50 deposit. A category B licence is required and the booking is placed through the online shop.

rows.name: RS Noma — piekabju noma Tukumā
rows.tagline: Dažādas vieglo automašīnu piekabes Tukumā — no 4 EUR/h un 18 EUR diennaktī
rows.descriptionEt: RS Noma rendib Tukumsis Kurzeme tanaval soiduautohaagiseid: uheteljelisi, kaheteljelisi, mootorrattahaagiseid ja kuni viie meetri pikkusi platvorme. Uheteljeline maksab 4 eurot tunnis ja 18 eurot opaevas, kaheteljeline 5 eurot tunnis ja 28 eurot opaevas, suurim 5-meetrine 35 eurot opaevas. Kinnitusvahendid kuuluvad hinna sisse.
rows.descriptionEn: RS Noma rents car trailers from Kurzemes iela in Tukums: single-axle, twin-axle, motorcycle trailers and platforms up to five metres. A single-axle unit is EUR 4/hour or EUR 18/day, a twin-axle EUR 5/hour or EUR 28/day, and the largest 5 m trailer EUR 35/day. Load-securing equipment is included free.

rows.name: SIA IVA 5
rows.tagline: Divasu platformas piekabes noma smagām kravām Aizkrauklē un Jaunjelgavā
rows.descriptionEt: SIA IVA 5 rendib Aizkraukles kaheteljelist Besttrailersi platvormhaagist pikkusega 4,5 meetrit ja kandevoimega 2500 kilo. Hind on 15 eurot tunnis ja 50 eurot opaevas ilma kaibemaksuta, tagatisraha 100 eurot. Haagis antakse ule Jaunjelgavas Lauku tanaval ja soovi korral saab tellida ka veoteenuse koos autojuhiga.
rows.descriptionEn: SIA IVA 5 in Aizkraukle rents a twin-axle Besttrailers platform trailer, 4.5 m long with a 2500 kg load capacity. The rate is EUR 15 per hour and EUR 50 per day excluding VAT, with a EUR 100 deposit. Pickup is at Lauku iela in Jaunjelgava and a driven haulage service can also be ordered.

rows.name: SIA Eldor
rows.tagline: Piekabju noma Valmierā, Rīgas ielā 66 — darba dienās 8:00–19:00
rows.descriptionEt: SIA Eldor rendib Valmiera Rigas tanaval soiduautohaagiseid. Kauplus on avatud toopaeviti 8-19 ja laupaeval 9-17, pühapaeval suletud. Haagised on saadaval kohapeal ilma pika etteteatamiseta.
rows.descriptionEn: SIA Eldor rents car trailers from its premises on Rīgas iela in Valmiera. The shop is open 08:00-19:00 on weekdays and 09:00-17:00 on Saturdays, closed Sundays. Trailers are available on site without long advance notice.

rows.name: Autonoma Valmiera (Nils Lielmanis)
rows.tagline: Piekabju noma Valmierā — piekabe no 3 EUR/h, autovedējs no 5 EUR/h
rows.descriptionEt: Autonoma Valmiera rendib B-kategooria soidukiga veetavaid haagiseid ja autoveohaagist. Tavaline haagis maksab 3 eurot tunnis ja 15 eurot opaevas, autoveohaagis 5 eurot tunnis ja 25 eurot opaevas, tagatisraha 50 eurot. Vajadusel saab rentida ka veduki ning tellida abi peale- ja mahalaadimisel.
rows.descriptionEn: Autonoma Valmiera rents trailers towable on a category B licence plus a car-transporter trailer. A standard trailer is EUR 3/hour or EUR 15/day, the car transporter EUR 5/hour or EUR 25/day, with a EUR 50 deposit. A towing vehicle can be hired as well and loading assistance is offered.

rows.name: SIA JE Grupa (JE Noma)
rows.address: Meistaru iela 3A-1, Ragana, Krimuldas pagasts, Siguldas novads, LV-2144
rows.tagline: Piekabju noma Raganā — vienass, kravas un slēgtās piekabes no 750 līdz 3000 kg
rows.descriptionEt: SIA JE Grupa rendib Raganas haagiseid taismassiga 750 kuni 3000 kilo: uheteljelisi 2,7 ja 3,2 meetrit, viiemeetrist kaubahaagist ja kinniseid Boeckmanni haagiseid. Uheteljeline maksab 8 eurot kuni kolm tundi ja 15 eurot opaevas, suurem kaubahaagis 25 eurot kuni kolm tundi ja 35 eurot opaevas. Ettevote asub Riia ja Sigulda vahelisel teel.
rows.descriptionEn: SIA JE Grupa rents trailers with gross weights from 750 to 3000 kg out of Ragana: single-axle units of 2.7 m and 3.2 m, a five-metre cargo trailer and enclosed Boeckmann models. A single-axle trailer costs EUR 8 for up to three hours or EUR 15 per day, the larger cargo trailer EUR 25 for three hours or EUR 35 per day. The yard sits on the road between Rīga and Sigulda.

rows.name: SIA Manfreds pluss
rows.tagline: Piekabju un tehnikas noma Liepājā, Lauku ielā 31/35
rows.descriptionEt: Manfreds pluss on Liepaja aia- ja metsatehnika kaupmees, kellel on ka rendiosakond, kus haagised on uks renditavate kategooriate hulgas niidukite ja muu tehnika korval. Tegemist on uhe vahese soltumatu haagiserentijaga Kurzemes valjaspool kutuseketti. Rendisoovid kaivad labi Lauku tanava kaupluse.
rows.descriptionEn: Manfreds pluss is a Liepāja dealer in garden and forestry machinery that also runs a rental desk, with trailers listed as one of its rental categories alongside mowers and other equipment. It is one of the few independent trailer renters in Kurzeme outside the fuel-station chains. Rental enquiries go through the shop on Lauku iela.

rows.name: Alvi Car Rent
rows.tagline: Auto noma biznesam un atpūtai — kravas furgoni no 45 EUR, piekabes no 25 EUR
rows.descriptionEt: Alvi Car Rent on Riia Zolitude autorendifirma, mis tootab opaevaringselt ja rendib peale soiduautode ka kaubikuid ning haagiseid. VW Crafteri opaevahind on 45 eurot ja Renault Masteril 50 eurot, haagised maksavad 25-40 eurot paevas. Asukoht Zolitudes on Riia lennujaama lahedal.
rows.descriptionEn: Alvi Car Rent is a Rīga rental firm in Zolitūde that operates around the clock and, alongside passenger cars, rents cargo vans and trailers. A VW Crafter is EUR 45 per day and a Renault Master EUR 50, while trailers run EUR 25-40 per day. The Zolitūde location is close to Rīga airport.

rows.name: Bus4rent — kravas busu noma
rows.tagline: Profesionāla kravas mikroautobusu noma Latvijā — no 60 EUR diennaktī
rows.descriptionEt: Bus4rent on Riia Janavartu tanaval tegutsev kaubikurendifirma, mis on turul enda soul ule 18 aasta. Pargis on VW Crafteri ja Mercedes Sprinteri kaubikud, tostukiga kaubikud, kulmikud ja kauba-reisibussid ning BE-kategooria haagised. Kaubiku opaevahind algab 60 eurost, kauba-reisibuss 70 eurot ja kulmik 80 eurot.
rows.descriptionEn: Bus4rent is a cargo-van rental firm on Jāņavārtu iela in Rīga that says it has more than 18 years in the business. The fleet covers VW Crafter and Mercedes Sprinter vans, tail-lift vans, refrigerated units, crew vans and BE-category trailers. Cargo vans start at EUR 60 per 24 hours, crew vans at EUR 70 and refrigerated vans at EUR 80.

rows.name: Busu Noma — Krimuldas iela, Rīga
rows.tagline: Kravas mikroautobusu, mikroautobusu un piekabju noma Rīgā
rows.descriptionEt: Busu Noma rendib Riia Krimuldas tanavalt kaubikuid kolme kuni kuue istekohaga, 6-20 kohaga mikrobusse, suuremaid busse ning ka haagiseid ja tehnikat. Firma pakub nii rendiautot ilma juhita kui ka veo- ja reisijateveoteenust koos juhiga. Pargis on muu hulgas Volkswagen Transporteri kaubikud.
rows.descriptionEn: Busu Noma rents cargo vans with three to six seats, 6-20 seat minibuses, full-size coaches and also trailers and equipment from Krimuldas iela in Rīga. The company offers both self-drive rental and driven cargo or passenger transport. The fleet includes Volkswagen Transporter cargo vans.

rows.name: SIA Buss76
rows.tagline: Mikroautobusu noma un kravu pārvadājumi Rīgā — vairāk nekā 30 transportlīdzekļu
rows.descriptionEt: SIA Buss76 on Riia veofirma, mille pargis on ule 30 eri suurusega mikrobussi ja kaubiku. Peale rendi pakub ettevote tais- ja osakoormaveosid ning autode evakueerimist. Sobib klientidele, kes soovivad kolimist koos juhiga, mitte iserenti.
rows.descriptionEn: SIA Buss76 is a Rīga transport company with a fleet of more than 30 minibuses and vans of various sizes. Besides rental it offers full and part-load freight as well as vehicle recovery. It suits customers who want a move handled with a driver rather than pure self-drive hire.

rows.name: INTERBUS SIA
rows.tagline: Kravas un kravas-pasažieru mikroautobusu noma un tirdzniecība Rīgā
rows.descriptionEt: INTERBUS on Riia Laidzes tanaval tegutsev kommertsoidukite muugi- ja rendifirma. Ettevote muub ja rendib kaubikuid, kauba-reisibusse ja platvormautosid ning pakub ka teenindust ja liisingut. Rendipariguid votab vastu eraldi rendinumber.
rows.descriptionEn: INTERBUS is a commercial-vehicle dealer and rental firm on Laidzes iela in Rīga. It sells and rents cargo vans, crew vans and flatbeds, and also offers servicing and leasing. Rental enquiries go to a dedicated rental phone line.

rows.name: SIA DEPPO — busu un vieglo auto noma
rows.tagline: Kravas furgonu un pasažieru mikroautobusu noma Ogrē — no 20 EUR dienā
rows.descriptionEt: SIA DEPPO rendib Ogres kaubikuid suure veoruumi ja kahe kuni kolme esiistmega, 7-9 kohalisi mikrobusse ja soiduautosid. Opaevahinnad jaavad vahemikku 20 kuni 120 eurot soidukituubist soltuvalt ning pakutakse nii luhi- kui pikaajalist renti kogu Euroopas soitmiseks. Kontor asub Druvas tanaval, park Martina tanaval.
rows.descriptionEn: SIA DEPPO in Ogre rents cargo vans with a large load area and two to three front seats, 7-9 seat minibuses and passenger cars. Day rates run from EUR 20 to EUR 120 depending on the vehicle, with both short and long-term plans valid for travel across Europe. The office is on Druvas iela and the yard on Mārtiņa iela.

rows.name: Rent Motors — auto un kravas furgonu noma Jelgavā
rows.tagline: Auto noma Jelgavā — 7–9 vietu mikroautobusi un B kategorijas kravas furgoni
rows.descriptionEt: Rent Motors on Jelgava Rigas tanaval tegutsev autorendifirma, mille pargis on peale soiduautode 7-9 kohalised mikrobussid ja B-kategooria kaubikud. Broneerida saab veebilehe otsinguvormi kaudu. Tegemist on uhe vahese kohaliku kaubikurentijaga Zemgales.
rows.descriptionEn: Rent Motors is a car rental firm on Rīgas iela in Jelgava whose fleet includes 7-9 seat minibuses and category B cargo vans alongside passenger cars. Bookings are made through the search form on its website. It is one of the few local cargo-van renters in the Zemgale region.

rows.name: SIA ADROL (Boxin)
rows.tagline: Mantu glabātuve Liepājā ar 24/7 piekļuvi, videonovērošanu un segtu izkraušanas zonu.
rows.descriptionEt: Boxin on Liepāja iseteenindusladu, kus era- ja ärikliendid saavad hoiustada mööblit, dokumente ja hooajakaupa erineva suurusega boksides. Objektid asuvad Cukura ja Ezermalas tänaval, ligipääs on 24/7, alal on videovalve ja kaetud laadimisala. Hinnad algavad umbes 36 eurost kuus väikseima boksi eest.
rows.descriptionEn: Boxin is a self-storage facility in Liepāja where private and business customers rent units from 1–2 m² up to 12+ m² for furniture, documents, inventory and seasonal items. Sites on Cukura iela and Ezermalas iela offer 24/7 access, video surveillance and a covered loading area. Listed prices run from about EUR 36.30/month for the smallest unit to EUR 225/month for 12+ m².

rows.name: SIA Laskana
rows.tagline: Stividora pakalpojumi, kravu apstrāde un loģistika Liepājas un Rojas ostās, vairāk nekā 30 gadu pieredze.
rows.descriptionEt: Laskana on Liepāja sadamas baasil tegutsev logistikaettevõte, mis pakub stividoriteenust, kauba käitlemist ja transporti Liepāja ning Roja sadamas. Ettevõte tegeleb ka metsamajanduse, puidu ostu-müügi ja laevaagentuuriga. Firma kirjeldab end oma valdkonna ühe suurima ettevõttena Lätis, üle 30 aasta kogemusega.
rows.descriptionEn: Laskana is a Liepāja port-based logistics company offering stevedoring, bulk cargo handling and haulage across three Latvian ports, plus ship agency services. It also runs forestry, timber trading and a truck repair workshop. The company describes itself as one of the largest in its sector in Latvia with more than 30 years of experience.

rows.name: SIA Ferro Terminal
rows.tagline: Noliktavu pakalpojumi Liepājas ostā: kravu uzglabāšana, iepakošana, marķēšana un svēršana.
rows.descriptionEt: Ferro Terminal on 2005. aastal Liepāja sadama territooriumil asutatud terminal, mis pakub laoteenuseid: kauba hoiustamist, pakkimist, sõelumist, markeerimist ja kaalumist. Lisaks osutab ettevõte laevaagentuuri- ja tollimaakleriteenuseid ning stividoriteenust. Kaupa veetakse uksest-ukseni mere-, auto- ja raudteetranspordiga.
rows.descriptionEn: Ferro Terminal, founded in 2005 inside Liepāja port, offers a full warehousing range: storage of goods, packing, screening out foreign matter, marking and weighing. It also provides shipping agency and customs broker services plus stevedoring in cooperation with independent surveyors. Cargo is moved door-to-door by sea, road and rail.

rows.name: SIA Liepaja Trans Storage
rows.tagline: Slēgtas, beramkravu, saldētavas un muitas noliktavas Liepājā, 15+ gadu pieredze kravu uzglabāšanā.
rows.descriptionEt: Liepaja Trans Storage on Liepāja majandustsooni laooperaator, kes pakub suletud ladusid tükikauba ja aluste jaoks, puistekaubaladu, külmladu ning tolliladu koos täieliku tolliarvestusega. Lisaks vormistatakse transiidi- ja impordi-ekspordideklaratsioone ning tehakse peale- ja mahalaadimist. Ettevõte rõhutab üle 15 aasta kogemust.
rows.descriptionEn: Liepaja Trans Storage is a warehouse operator in the Liepāja Special Economic Zone offering closed warehouses for general and palletised cargo, bulk cargo warehouses, cold storage for frozen goods and fruit, and bonded customs warehouses with full customs accounting. It also handles transit declarations, import/export paperwork and loading services, citing 15+ years of experience.

rows.name: LSEZ SIA Dan Store
rows.tagline: Beramkravu pārkraušana un uzglabāšana Liepājas ostā ar tiešu dzelzceļa pievadu.
rows.descriptionEt: Dan Store on Liepāja sadama terminal, mis tegeleb puistekauba käitlemise ja ladustamisega ning pakub paindlikke logistikalahendusi. Terminalil on otsene raudteeühendus, kaasaegne infrastruktuur ja oma labor teravilja ning rapsi kvaliteedikontrolliks. Päevane laadimisvõimekus on kuni 18 000 tonni.
rows.descriptionEn: Dan Store operates a bulk cargo terminal in Liepāja port, handling and storing loose cargo with direct rail access, modern infrastructure and qualified staff. It runs its own laboratory for grain and rapeseed quality control. The facility can load up to 18,000 tonnes of grain per day and discharge up to 5,000 tonnes.

rows.name: AMELA1
rows.tagline: Piekabju noma Liepājā ar piegādi: 3 EUR/stundā, 12 EUR/dienā, 17 EUR/diennaktī.
rows.descriptionEt: AMELA1 rendib Liepājas haagiseid ehitusmaterjalide, kütte, kolimiskraami ja muu veoks. Neptun-haagise sisemõõdud on 2360 x 1290 x 300 mm ja kandevõime 615 kg, olemas on kallutusfunktsioon. Kohaletoomine kuni 5 km on tasuta, edasi 8 eurot iga 10 km kohta, tagatisraha 20 eurot.
rows.descriptionEn: AMELA1 rents trailers in Liepāja for building materials, solid fuel, moving loads and other cargo. The Neptun trailer has internal dimensions of 2360 x 1290 x 300 mm, a 615 kg payload and a tipping function. Rates are EUR 3/hour (min 3 hours), EUR 12/day or EUR 17 per 24 hours, with a EUR 20 deposit; delivery is free within 5 km.

rows.name: SIA Bolivar Logistic
rows.tagline: Negabarīta un smagsvara kravu pārvadājumi, kompleksi multimodāli risinājumi no Liepājas.
rows.descriptionEt: Bolivar Logistic on Liepājas asuv veoettevõte, mis on spetsialiseerunud ülegabariidiliste ja raskekaaluliste vedude ning keeruliste multimodaalsete transpordilahenduste korraldamisele. Veetakse põllumajandus- ja ehitustehnikat, energeetikaseadmeid, kraanasid, tööstusseadmeid, laevu ja jahte ning moodulehitisi. Teenindatakse nii maantee-, mere- kui raudteeliine.
rows.descriptionEn: Bolivar Logistic is a Liepāja-based transport company focused exclusively on out-of-gauge (OOG) and heavy cargo, including complex multimodal projects. It moves agricultural and construction machinery, energy and aviation equipment, cranes, industrial plant, ships and yachts, modular structures and industrial pipes. Services cover road, sea and rail legs.

rows.name: SIA Ultima
rows.tagline: Lielgabarīta un smagsvara pārvadājumi, speciālo atļauju noformēšana un kravu ekspedīcija.
rows.descriptionEt: Ultima on Liepājas registreeritud ekspedeerimisettevõte, mis pakub täisteenust projekt-, ülegabariidiliste ja raskeveoste transpordil üle maailma. Ettevõte vormistab eriveolubasid Euroopas, Valgevenes ja Ukrainas ning korraldab kaubaekspeditsiooni. Teenus katab kogu ahela alates marsruudi planeerimisest kuni dokumentideni.
rows.descriptionEn: Ultima is a Liepāja-registered freight forwarder providing a full service package for project, oversized and heavy cargo transport worldwide. It arranges special permits for oversized and heavy shipments across Europe, Belarus and Ukraine, and offers general cargo forwarding. The company covers the whole chain from route planning to documentation.

rows.name: Uzkopšana Liepāja
rows.tagline: Dzīvokļu, biroju un pēcremonta uzkopšana Liepājā: regulārā no 50 EUR, ģenerālā no 70 EUR.
rows.descriptionEt: Uzkopšana Liepāja pakub Liepājas korterite, majade ja büroode koristusteenust, sealhulgas suurpuhastust, remondijärgset koristust ja keemilist puhastust. Hinnakiri algab: regulaarne koristus alates 50 eurost, generaalpuhastus alates 70 eurost, keemiline puhastus alates 20 eurost. Tööstuskoristust pakutakse alates 0,05 eurost ruutmeetri kohta.
rows.descriptionEn: Uzkopšana Liepāja provides apartment, house and office cleaning in Liepāja, including deep/seasonal cleaning, post-renovation cleaning and upholstery dry cleaning. Published starting prices are EUR 50 for regular cleaning, EUR 70 for a deep or seasonal clean, EUR 70 for post-renovation work and EUR 20 for chemical cleaning. Industrial cleaning starts from EUR 0.05/m².

rows.name: SIA Sorbus Serviss
rows.tagline: Profesionāls uzkopšanas serviss Liepājā ar individuālu objekta novērtējumu un tāmi.
rows.descriptionEt: Sorbus Serviss on Liepāja koristusettevõte, mis alustab tööd objekti ülevaatuse ja individuaalse pakkumisega ning saadab seejärel kohale oma koristusmeeskonna. Teenindatakse nii kodusid kui ka ärikliente. Ettevõte on registreeritud aadressil Bāriņu iela 21, Liepājas.
rows.descriptionEn: Sorbus Serviss is a Liepāja cleaning company that works to a three-step process: first contact, an on-site assessment with a tailored quote, then deployment of its cleaning team. It serves both households and commercial premises. The company is registered at Bāriņu iela 21 in Liepāja.

rows.name: SIA Ventplac
rows.tagline: Atklātā tipa noliktava un kravu pārkraušana Ventspils ostā: apaļkoki, šķelda, granulas, beramkravas.
rows.descriptionEt: Ventplac on Ventspilsi sadama terminal, mis tegeleb ümarpalgi ja puistekauba ladustamise ning ümberlaadimisega avatud tüüpi laoplatsil. Käideldavad kaubad on ümarpuit, tselluloosihake, kütte- ja puiduhake ning graanulid. Terminal asub Rūpniecības ielā 25, kontor Rūpniecības ielā 11.
rows.descriptionEn: Ventplac operates an open-type storage and transhipment terminal in Ventspils port for round timber and bulk cargo. Handled goods include round logs, cellulose chips, fuel chips, wood chips and pellets, loaded to and from ships. The terminal is at Rūpniecības iela 25 with the office at Rūpniecības iela 11.

rows.name: All OverSeas SIA
rows.tagline: Kuģu aģentēšana, kravu ekspedīcija un loģistikas uzraudzība Ventspilī.
rows.descriptionEt: All OverSeas on Ventspilsi asuv ettevõte, mis pakub tugiteenuseid laevandus- ja kaubandussektorile. Teenuste hulka kuuluvad sadamaagentuur, laevamaakleri teenus, logistika järelevalve ja ekspedeerimine. Ettevõte ühendab meretranspordi sisemaa veo ja laohoidlatega.
rows.descriptionEn: All OverSeas is a Ventspils company providing support services to the shipping and trade industries. Its capabilities include port agency, shipbrokerage, logistics supervision and freight forwarding. The firm positions itself as the bridge between seaborne trades and inland transport and storage facilities.

rows.name: SIA Venta Transports
rows.tagline: Kravu pārvadājumi un loģistika Latvijā un ES: ostas kravas, kokmateriāli, šķelda, negabarīta kravas.
rows.descriptionEt: Venta Transports on Ventspilsi veoettevõte, mis korraldab kaubavedu üle Läti ja Euroopa Liidu ning pakub logistikateenuseid. Veetakse sadamakaupa, vedelkaupa, ohtlikke veoseid, puitu ja haket, turvast, teravilja ning ülegabariidilist kaupa. Ettevõttel puudub oma veebileht, andmed pärinevad ettevõtete kataloogist.
rows.descriptionEn: Venta Transports is a Ventspils haulier moving cargo throughout Latvia and the EU and providing logistics services. It handles port cargo, liquid cargo, hazardous goods, timber and wood chips, peat, grain and oversized loads, plus express deliveries. The company has no website of its own; details come from a business directory.

rows.name: Noord Natie Ventspils Terminals
rows.tagline: Universāls kravu terminālis un noliktavu pakalpojumi Ventspils brīvostā.
rows.descriptionEt: Noord Natie Ventspils Terminals on Ventspilsi vabasadama universaalterminal, mis pakub laoteenuseid ja kauba käitlemist. Ettevõtte varasem domeen nnvt.lv ei lahene enam, seetõttu on veebilehe väli tühi ja kontaktid pärinevad ettevõtete kataloogist. Aadress on Plosta iela 7, Ventspils.
rows.descriptionEn: Noord Natie Ventspils Terminals is a multipurpose cargo terminal in the Ventspils Free Port offering warehousing and cargo handling. Its former domain nnvt.lv no longer resolves, so no website is recorded and the contact details come from a business directory. The terminal is located at Plosta iela 7.

rows.name: SIA VRautonoma.lv
rows.tagline: Kravas busu un minivenu noma Jelgavā no 20 EUR dienā, īstermiņā un ilgtermiņā.
rows.descriptionEt: VRautonoma.lv on Jelgava autorendiettevõte, mis rendib kaubikuid ja minibusse nii lühi- kui pikaajaliselt. Hinnanäited: VW Sharan 7 kohta 20 eurot päevas, VW Caravelle 7 kohta 50 eurot päevas, Peugeot 3008 25 eurot päevas. Ettevõte on tegutsenud viis aastat.
rows.descriptionEn: VRautonoma.lv is a Jelgava rental company offering cargo vans (kravas busi) and 7-seat minivans for short and long-term hire. Sample rates include EUR 20/day for a VW Sharan, EUR 25/day for a Peugeot 3008 and EUR 50/day for a VW Caravelle. The company says it has been operating for five years.

rows.name: SIA L S H Express Logistics
rows.tagline: Noliktavu pakalpojumi ar iepakošanu un iekraušanu, multimodālie kravu pārvadājumi un muitošana.
rows.descriptionEt: L S H Express Logistics on Jelgavas registreeritud ekspedeerimisettevõte, mis pakub laoteenuseid koos pakkimise ja laadimisega. Lisaks korraldatakse konteinervedusid üle maailma, multimodaalset transporti, laevade prahtimist ning impordi-ekspordi tolliformaalsusi. Ettevõtte kontor asub Rīgas, registrijärgne aadress Jelgavas.
rows.descriptionEn: L S H Express Logistics is a freight forwarder registered in Jelgava that offers warehousing services including packing and loading. It also arranges worldwide container shipments, multimodal transport, ship chartering, project cargo and customs clearance. Its operating office is in Rīga while the registered address is Niedru iela 7, Jelgava.

rows.name: SIA ANDERMAN
rows.tagline: Biroju telpu uzkopšana, ģenerāltīrīšana, logu mazgāšana un teritorijas kopšana Jelgavā.
rows.descriptionEt: Anderman on Jelgava teenusettevõte, mis pakub büroopindade koristust, suurpuhastust, akende pesu ja territooriumi hooldust. Lisaks osutatakse töötervishoiu, tuleohutusdokumentatsiooni, ISO juurutamise ja kinnisvarahalduse teenuseid. Ettevõte on registreeritud aadressil Blaumaņa iela 10-37, Jelgavas.
rows.descriptionEn: Anderman is a Jelgava services company offering office cleaning, general/deep cleaning, window washing and grounds maintenance. It also provides occupational health services, fire-safety documentation, ISO implementation, public procurement support and property management. It is registered at Blaumaņa iela 10-37 in Jelgava.

rows.name: SIA 3PL Distribution
rows.tagline: Noliktavu pakalpojumi un trešās puses loģistika Jelgavas rūpnieciskajā zonā.
rows.descriptionEt: 3PL Distribution on Jelgava tööstuspiirkonnas Rūpniecības ielā 52 tegutsev laoteenuse pakkuja. Ettevõte on kataloogis liigitatud laoteenuste (noliktavu pakalpojumi) alla ja pakub kolmanda osapoole logistika- ning distributsioonilahendusi. Oma veebilehte ettevõttel ei ole, andmed pärinevad ettevõtete kataloogist.
rows.descriptionEn: 3PL Distribution is a warehousing provider located in Jelgava's industrial zone at Rūpniecības iela 52. It is listed under warehouse services and offers third-party logistics and distribution solutions. The company has no website of its own, so the details come from a business directory.

rows.name: SIA Gamma SP
rows.tagline: Kravu pārvadājumi ar auto un loģistikas pakalpojumi Jelgavā, Dobeles šosejā.
rows.descriptionEt: Gamma SP on Jelgava veoettevõte, mis tegeleb autokaubaveo ja logistikaga. Ettevõte asub Dobeles šoseja 10, Jelgavas. Ettevõtte veebileht gammasp.lv ei olnud kontrollimise hetkel kättesaadav, seetõttu on veebiaadress tühjaks jäetud.
rows.descriptionEn: Gamma SP is a Jelgava haulage company providing road freight transport and logistics services. It is based at Dobeles šoseja 10 in Jelgava. Its website gammasp.lv could not be retrieved at the time of checking, so no website URL is recorded here.

rows.name: SIA West Resource (Jelgavas Uzkopšanas Serviss 1-2-Tīrs)
rows.tagline: Uzkopšanas serviss Jelgavā: mīksto mēbeļu tīrīšana, grīdas segumi, telpu ģenerālā uzkopšana.
rows.descriptionEt: Jelgavas Uzkopšanas Serviss 1-2-Tīrs (juriidiline nimi SIA West Resource) pakub Jelgavas koristusteenust, pehme mööbli puhastust ja põrandakatete hooldust. Ettevõte teeb nii regulaarset kui ka suurpuhastust. Oma veebilehte ei ole, andmed pärinevad ettevõtete kataloogidest.
rows.descriptionEn: Jelgavas Uzkopšanas Serviss 1-2-Tīrs (legal entity SIA West Resource) provides cleaning services in Jelgava, including upholstery cleaning and soft floor-covering care. It offers both regular maintenance cleaning and one-off deep cleans. The business has no website of its own, so details come from business directories.

rows.name: ENTREGA SIA
rows.tagline: Kravu pārvadājumi no durvīm līdz durvīm Eiropā un NVS: pilnas un daļējas kravas, negabarīts.
rows.descriptionEt: Entrega on Jūrmalas registreeritud ekspedeerimisettevõte, mis korraldab uksest-ukseni kaubavedu Euroopas ja SRÜ riikides. Veetakse täis- ja osakoormaid, ülegabariidilist ning ohtlikku kaupa; kasutuses on kaubikud, kastiautod, madelid, eritehnika ja manipulaatorid. Ettevõte tegeleb ka multimodaalse veo korraldamise, kauba jälgimise ja dokumentide vormistamisega.
rows.descriptionEn: Entrega is a Jūrmala-registered freight forwarder arranging door-to-door delivery across Europe and the CIS. It moves full and partial loads, oversized and hazardous cargo using vans, box trucks, flatbeds, specialised equipment and truck-mounted cranes. Services also include multimodal transport organisation, cargo tracking and documentation handling.

rows.name: SIA EU Global Service
rows.tagline: Visu veidu kravu pārvadājumi Latvijā un starptautiski, GPS kravas izsekošana, noliktava Vācijā.
rows.descriptionEt: EU Global Service on Jūrmalas registreeritud veoettevõte, mis pakub kõiki kaubaveo liike nii Läti-siseselt kui rahvusvaheliselt. Ettevõttel on laopind Saksamaal ja GPS-jälgimisega veokid, mis võimaldab kliendil koorma asukohta jälgida. Pakutakse individuaalseid logistikalahendusi.
rows.descriptionEn: EU Global Service is a Jūrmala-registered transport company offering all types of cargo transport, both domestic and international. It operates warehouse capacity in Germany and GPS-equipped vehicles so customers can track their consignment. The company builds customised logistics solutions for its clients.

rows.name: BALTROUTE SIA
rows.tagline: Auto, jūras, avio un dzelzceļa pārvadājumi, muitas brokeris un noliktavas pakalpojumi kravu sagatavošanai.
rows.descriptionEt: Baltroute on Jūrmalas registreeritud rahvusvaheline ekspedeerimisettevõte, mis korraldab maantee-, mere-, lennu- ja raudteevedu, sealhulgas rongiliini Hiinast. Ettevõte pakub tollimaakleri teenust ning impordi-ekspordi dokumentide vormistamist. Lisaks osutatakse laoteenust kauba hoiustamiseks ja veoks ettevalmistamiseks.
rows.descriptionEn: Baltroute is a Jūrmala-registered international freight forwarder handling road, sea, air and rail transport, including rail services from China. It provides customs brokerage and import/export documentation. The company also offers warehouse services for storing and preparing cargo before onward transport.

rows.name: SIA LewARTS
rows.tagline: Noliktavu pakalpojumi Jūrmalā, Jūrkalnes ielā 6A.
rows.descriptionEt: LewARTS on üks väheseid Jūrmalas endas registreeritud laoteenuse pakkujaid, asukohaga Jūrkalnes ielā 6A. Ettevõte on kataloogis liigitatud laoteenuste (noliktavu pakalpojumi) alla. Oma veebilehte ettevõttel ei ole, andmed pärinevad ettevõtete kataloogist.
rows.descriptionEn: LewARTS is one of the few warehousing providers actually registered in Jūrmala, at Jūrkalnes iela 6A. It is listed in business directories under warehouse services (noliktavu pakalpojumi). The company has no website of its own, so all details come from a directory listing.

rows.name: SIA FS Noma
rows.tagline: Kravas mikroautobusu, pasažieru busu un piekabju noma Tukumā no 9,99 EUR dienā, arī pārvākšanās.
rows.descriptionEt: FS Noma rendib Tukumas eri klassi sõiduautosid, reisi- ja kaubamikrobusse ning erinevat tüüpi haagiseid. Lisaks pakub ettevõte kolimisteenust, transfeeri koos juhiga ja autoabi. Hinnad algavad 9,99 eurost päevas ökonoomklassi puhul ja ulatuvad kuni ligikaudu 55 euroni päevas suuremate sõidukite eest.
rows.descriptionEn: FS Noma rents cars of various classes, passenger minibuses, cargo vans and several types of trailers in Tukums. The company also offers moving services, chauffeur-driven transfers and vehicle towing/recovery. Daily rates start at EUR 9.99 for economy class and reach roughly EUR 55/day for premium and full-size vehicles.

rows.name: SIA Kaucminde
rows.tagline: Ķīmiskā tīrīšana, veļas mazgāšana un telpu uzkopšana Tukumā kopš 2013. gada.
rows.descriptionEt: Kaucminde on 2013. aastast tegutsev Tukuma ettevõte, mis pakub keemilist puhastust, pesumaja teenust ja hooldusteenuseid. Pestakse tööriideid, hotellitekstiili ja vaipu ning tehakse büroode koristust, põrandahooldust, akende pesu ja territooriumi hooldust. Ettevõte müüb ka professionaalset puhastuskeemiat. Veebileht kaucminde.eu ei lahene enam, seetõttu on väli tühi.
rows.descriptionEn: Kaucminde has operated in Tukums since 2013 providing dry cleaning, laundry and facility maintenance services. It launders workwear, hotel linen and carpets, and carries out office cleaning, floor care, window washing and grounds upkeep. It also sells professional cleaning chemicals. The domain kaucminde.eu no longer resolves, so no website URL is recorded.
